title: habenaria acuifera var. rostrata
intro:
Habenaria acuifera var. rostrata, commonly known as the "Himalayan Yellow Orchid", is a type of orchid that belongs to the Asclepiadaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Habenaria acuifera var. rostrata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which help to alleviate symptoms and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.

Note: More research is needed to confirm the specific bioactive constituents of this plant.
